scope: Bounded i32 production parse/pretty/compile/execute oracle, not CNF or general AST-ID canonicalization (#1042). Integer expression depth <= 2, loop trips <= 3, distinct leaf trace IDs, normal production overflow settings.

sampleAccounting.discardPolicy: A rejected supposedly well-typed sample fails; no success-shaped discard. FsCheck reports replay seeds on failure.
sampleAccounting.structuralNormalization: Ignore incidental IDs and expand unique generated _hoist temporaries into expression children. Literal values, operators, names, types, effects and child positions remain compared; runtime observations independently check hoist placement/order.

constructs.name: printed-i32-literals
constructs.fallback: Other literal types retain existing smoke tests; they are outside this i32 behavioral generator.

constructs.name: nested-i32-arithmetic
constructs.fallback: Only signed i32 +,-,*,/ are modeled; other numeric types/operators require additional independent evaluator rules, not silent coercion.

constructs.name: conditional-expressions
constructs.fallback: Generated conditions compare i32 to zero; unsupported condition types are not claimed.

constructs.name: short-circuit-and-or
constructs.fallback: Right-operand evaluation is forbidden when short-circuited; no eager fallback.

constructs.name: bounded-for-and-mutable-accumulator
constructs.fallback: Only ascending inclusive ranges of 0..3 iterations are generated; unbounded loops are explicitly rejected by the generator/evaluator.

constructs.name: statement-match-literal-default
constructs.fallback: Only literal-zero and default arms with return expressions are generated; no claim for arbitrary pattern families.

constructs.name: collection-mutation-and-call-order
constructs.fallback: Trace lists are externally allocated; depth and loop bounds limit appends. The oracle checks exact visited leaf IDs, including traces before exceptions.

constructs.name: generic-methods-async-raw-csharp-unbounded-loops
constructs.fallback: Unsupported generated modes throw NotSupportedException before execution. This is a test-subset boundary, not a production-language support claim. Separate ordinary suites cover these language features.
